title: The Effectiveness of Prophylactic Antibiotics for Urethral Bulking
official: The Effectiveness of Prophylactic Antibiotics for Urethral Bulking
summary: The goal of this clinical trial is to evaluate if prophylactic antibiotics in urethral bulking are effective in reducing postprocedural urinary tract infections.
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients scheduled to undergo a urethral bulking procedure
* Age 18 ≥ over

Exclusion Criteria:

* History of recurrent urinary tract infections
* Known history of urinary retention
* Allergies or contraindications to multiple antibiotics
* Inability to tolerate oral antibiotics
* Concomitant surgical procedures at the time of urethral bulking
* Pregnant or breastfeeding
